{{short description|Welsh experimental physicist (1925–2018)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
Professor '''Douglas Forbes Brewer''' (22 May 1925 – 16 July 2018) was a Welsh experimental physicist at the [[University of Sussex]], known for his work in [[cryogenics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thetimes.com/uk/science/article/professor-douglas-brewer-obituary-mdf3p0rw9|title=Professor Douglas Brewer obituary|date=23 October 2018|website=The Times|access-date=24 October 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sussex.ac.uk/broadcast/read/46012|title=Obituary: Douglas Brewer (1925-2018)|first=Sean|last=Armstrong|website=Sussex.ac.uk|accessdate=24 October 2018|archive-date=25 October 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181025071024/http://www.sussex.ac.uk/broadcast/read/46012|url-status=dead}}</ref>
